# Code review — nrscholar-frontend

## Workflow

1. Read the diff (`git diff develop...HEAD` or the PR) and the description. Flag mismatches.
2. Walk the checklist. For each finding: severity, file:line, the problem, a failure scenario, a fix.
3. Verify before reporting. Skip pure style that tooling would catch.

Severity: 🔴 **Blocker** · 🟡 **Should fix** · 🟢 **Nit**

## Checklist

**Correctness**
- [ ] Handles `success: false`, the offline 503, a missing token, missing fields, empty data.
- [ ] Effects have correct dependencies and clean up timers/listeners/animations/3D.
- [ ] No double submits. No state updates after unmount. Quick taps vs. slow responses handled.
- [ ] XP, rewards, scoring, streak and screen-time logic unchanged unless intended. Caches cleared after changes.

**Child safety & security**
- [ ] The parental gate and parent-only routes are intact. Screen-time can't be bypassed.
- [ ] No new personal data collection, third-party SDKs, or data in URLs. No tokens in new places.
- [ ] No `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. Safe external links. Escaped WebView injection.

**Architecture & contracts**
- [ ] API calls via `apiFetch` in the feature's `api.ts` + hooks (web) or `services/api.ts` (mobile).
- [ ] Web routes the mobile shell opens unchanged, or updated in both apps.
- [ ] No new libraries without approval. Reuses shared components.

**UI**
- [ ] Theme tokens (no new hex). 360px + WebView OK. Touch targets.
- [ ] Loading/error/empty states. Child-friendly copy.
- [ ] `t()` everywhere, keys in en/hi/gu.
- [ ] Accessible labels, alt text, not color-only feedback.

**Performance**
- [ ] Heavy screens lazy. Assets reasonable. No request per item. No duplicate `/api/users/me` calls.

**Standards & hygiene**
- [ ] No new `any`, `console.log`, empty `catch`, magic storage keys/routes, or abbreviations.
- [ ] Files < ~400 lines (don't grow legacy giants).
- [ ] Conventional Commit title. Template filled in. Screenshots. No unrelated changes or `.expo/` cache files.

## Output

```
## Summary
## Findings
🔴 path:line — problem. Scenario … Fix …
🟡 …
🟢 …
## Verified / not verified
```
